phases.objective: Make the shared environment convergence engine the canonical Staging drift and plan authority; exact-bind repository and Gateway release identity; activate a focused server-governed Staging Activation Gateway apply adapter whose Cloudflare target is resolved only from the Staging profile and canonical resource-authority binding; keep operator acknowledgement non-executive and automatic apply disabled; retire direct workflow/provider dispatch from AutoPilot; publish exact public Recovery trust evidence from the deployed Worker; install only the bounded local trusted-ingress allowlist after that public evidence is exact; permit one local runtime retry solely after successful trust installation; preserve the existing Production rollout implementation and keep Production mutation forbidden; and retain profile-validated packaged-policy fallback for flattened runtime images.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: An exact Staging release certifies ready from a canonical profile-resolved policy and profile-owned Gateway endpoint; only an explicitly marked synthetic loopback fixture may override the probe base. A healthy Gateway on an older exact SHA remains non-ready and is classified as governed convergence drift.
steps: Load the canonical environment-convergence registry and resolve the Staging Gateway policy server-side from its profile.
Validate policy key, public host and expected policy hash before constructing or probing the Gateway endpoint.
Reject caller-selected policy paths and reject Gateway URL overrides unless the override is an explicitly marked synthetic loopback fixture.
For a profile-valid reachable Gateway, keep gateway_health_reachable as integrity evidence but evaluate gateway_exact_commit and gateway_recovery_trusted_ingress as readiness/convergence evidence.
Classify healthy stale release identity as convergence drift with repairability=governed and automatic_apply_allowed=false.
Retain certification as the final judge and require exact Gateway release identity and exact Recovery trust identity for release readiness.
Keep the certifier read-only with no provider, database, migration, Production, ruleset or secret mutation.
assertions: The Staging certification policy must match activation_gateway_staging, activation-dev.mad4b.com and the profile expected_policy_hash before any external Gateway probe.
The live certifier does not read STAGING_CERT_GATEWAY_POLICY_PATH or any other caller-selected policy path.
A Gateway base override is accepted only when STAGING_CERT_SYNTHETIC_LOOPBACK_FIXTURE is true and the resolved host is loopback; all other overrides fail closed before the Gateway probe.
gateway_environment_profile_current remains an integrity failure and manual_non_repairable when false.
gateway_exact_commit is convergence_drift/release_identity_mismatch, not integrity corruption.
gateway_recovery_trusted_ingress remains governed convergence drift when local trust is not exact.
An exact Gateway SHA, policy hash and Recovery trust identity remain required for release-ready certification.
Live certification performs no provider or Production mutation.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: AutoPilot consumes report.convergence.next_governed_handoff from the shared engine, produces a repository/policy/observed-state-bound immutable plan with a server-resolved execution target, never performs provider/workflow mutation itself, and may perform one local runtime retry only after exact public Recovery trust evidence is safely installed into the bounded Staging trust allowlist.
steps: Run the local Staging core once and treat its certification state as observation evidence.
If local Recovery trust is not exact, dry-run the local trust installer against profile-owned public Gateway /health and /ready evidence before any local change.
When public Gateway evidence is already exact, update only the eight trusted-ingress allowlist keys and retry the local core once so the runtime consumes the new public trust binding.
When public Gateway evidence is not exact, perform no local trust mutation and pass observed blocking/degraded reasons to the shared environment convergence bridge.
Build an immutable convergence plan whose plan_sha256 binds canonical repository, branch, exact commit, desired and observed Gateway policy identity, and the server-resolved execution target.
Resolve bundle and Cloudflare Worker resource binding from the environment profile/server authority; callers do not select the provider execution target.
Consume report.convergence.next_governed_handoff as the only convergence next-action source.
Treat operator_acknowledgement as non-execution acknowledgement; retain approval_checkpoint only as a transitional compatibility alias.
Expose execution_ready=true and activation_gateway_dark_deploy only when the focused server-governed adapter is profile-bound and ready; automatic_apply_allowed remains false.
Keep the legacy Converge-StagingActivationGateway helper as a retired, non-mutating compatibility tombstone and guard all orchestrators against direct provider commands and workflow dispatch.
assertions: ReleaseSpec repository exactly equals mad4bdigital-ai/multi-business-multi-role-growth-intelligence-os.
The Staging profile is bound to staging_activation_gateway_profile_apply, activation_gateway_dark_deploy, governed_apply_ready=true and resource_binding_id=5a2b04f8-bb99-4f65-a924-0f55d3080376.
The execution target is server-resolved and caller target override is forbidden.
operator_acknowledgement_is_execution_authority=false and approval_checkpoint is only a transitional alias.
automatic_apply_allowed remains false even when the governed handoff is execution-ready.
Invoke-Staging-One-Click.ps1 contains no hardcoded Gateway drift-key allowlist, no Cloudflare provider credential read, no provider API call and no GitHub workflow dispatch.
The local trust installer first proves exact public SHA/policy/trust evidence, then may update only its eight-key trust allowlist; unrelated .env.staging values remain unchanged.
The local core may be retried at most once and only after exact_public_gateway_trust_installed_locally.
Converge-StagingActivationGateway.ps1 performs no workflow dispatch, provider mutation, trust installation, database mutation or Production mutation.
Provider, Cloudflare, workflow-dispatch, database and Production mutation flags remain false in AutoPilot results.

e2e_journeys.actor: Server-governed Staging Activation Gateway apply authority
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The exact Staging profile resolves one canonical Cloudflare Worker binding, builds an exact-SHA signed Worker bundle, applies it only through the existing governed Activation Gateway rollout surface after typed confirmation/capability authorization, verifies public /health, /ready and Recovery trust identity in the same cycle, returns only non-secret trust evidence, and rolls back on failed readback without widening Production or DNS authority.
steps: Load and validate the exact Staging environment profile, policy hash, bundle key, entrypoint, public host, apply capability and fixed resource_binding_id.

Resolve account/script only from platform_resource_authority_bindings; treat caller account/script fields only as assertions and reject caller resource IDs, policy paths, bundle keys, entrypoints, public hosts, zones, DNS records and custom domains.

Build the Staging Worker from the exact requested source SHA, generate a signed deployment attestation and a separate Ed25519 Recovery ingress signing key, and bind the public trust bundle to that exact release identity.
Require the Staging feature flag, typed policy confirmation, execution nonce, exact capability envelope and active runtime dispatch certification before apply.
Upload only the fixed Worker script and generated Worker secrets using server-held provider authority; do not mutate DNS or custom-domain routing.
Read back the Cloudflare deployment and then require exact public activation-dev.mad4b.com /health and /ready SHA/policy/trust evidence.
Return the public Recovery trust bundle without private/provider secrets and audit/finalize the single-use capability envelope.
If any post-write step fails, restore the previous deployment versions or delete the new unrouted script and mark the envelope failed.
assertions: The server adapter resolves resource_binding_id=5a2b04f8-bb99-4f65-a924-0f55d3080376 from the Staging profile and resolves account/script from that canonical binding.
Caller-selected provider targets, policy paths and provider credentials are not accepted execution authority.
The Staging target is mad4b-activation-gateway-staging with activation_gateway_staging policy hash c6468e051b8456d4d3ffc6478cdb98f7048b69c8ca6742f4dca27e1eb4023f32.
Apply requires exact source SHA, typed confirmation, execution nonce, single-use capability envelope, dispatch certification, audit evidence and same-cycle readback.
Worker apply does not write DNS or custom-domain bindings and does not deploy Production.
The public Recovery trust bundle contains an Ed25519 public key and exact release identity but no private key, provider credential or secret value.

The existing Production Activation Gateway rollout implementation remains isolated in activationGatewayRolloutToolProduction.js and the generic wrapper only delegates Staging-matching requests to the focused adapter.
The execution path does not perform business/schema database mutation; only existing governance envelope/audit lifecycle writes are permitted.
Automatic rollback is required after any failed provider/public readback.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A flattened runtime whose repository root resolves to the filesystem root can reach the configured packaged Staging policy fallback after safe repository-relative containment checks, while traversal and profile hash mismatch remain fail-closed.
steps: Resolve repository containment with path.relative so filesystem-root containment is handled correctly.
Reject absolute and parent-traversal policy_path forms before resolving the repository candidate.
Attempt the canonical repository policy candidate first and the configured packaged absolute policy candidate second.
Validate policy key, public host and expected policy hash after loading either candidate.
Run the regression through the imported Spec017 test manifest and registered activation/environment test authority.
assertions: A missing repository policy under filesystem-root repositoryRoot falls back to a valid configured packaged policy.
A policy_path containing '..' fails with activation_gateway_policy_path_outside_repository:staging.
A packaged policy with a mismatched expected hash fails with activation_gateway_profile_policy_invalid:staging:policy_hash.
The regression test remains registered in the canonical full test manifest and the test-authority registry.
Live Staging certification remains required and production_mutation_allowed remains false.
No provider, database, DNS, secret, ruleset or Production mutation is introduced by the packaged-policy fallback.
